On the plate

Photos from the beach bar’s own Google listing.

Ammos at Makenzie Beach

Ammos sits directly on Makenzie Beach in Larnaca: a white building with the lit “ammos” lettering, sun loungers on the sand and the sea a few steps away. Guests on Google describe it as elegant and relaxed during the day, with sushi, burgers and seafood from the kitchen, and in the evening as a lively place with a DJ and cocktails. Several of them mention the sunset and the view of the planes coming in to land.

Open every day from the morning until late at night. 100,000 people follow Ammos Beach Bar on Facebook.
